categories.label: Klassen A1, A2, A und B196

notes: 7 tests x 30 = 210, every item used once in tests (pools exactly 7x each count). Each test is 15 Grundstoff (motorcycle-perspective) + 15 Zusatzstoff: the real first-licence test is 20 + 10 (TÜV NORD), the motorcycle part is weighted up on purpose (research note). Training: five topic sets 22201-22205 (Fahrtechnik 35; Schutz+Technik 35; Sozius+Klassen 35; Gefahren+Verhalten 56; Vorfahrt+Zeichen+Umwelt/Eignung 49) = 5 sets + 7 tests = 12 steps. passPct 93 = 28 of 30, as detheorie (point weighting not modelled).
